args.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.distregistry,
    AVG(t2.deliverysuccessrate) AS avg_delivery_success_rate,
    t2.lastmilestatus
FROM 
    disasterevents AS t1
JOIN 
    transportation AS t2 ON t1.distregistry = t2.transportdistref
GROUP BY 
    t1.distregistry, t2.lastmilestatus;
